versions.description: Force you to Alternate P1 and P2 controls

about:
# Force Alternate
Forces strict alternating input in 2-player levels — P1 and P2 must take turns pressing. Press out of turn and your input gets blocked. Enable hard mode if you want a death instead.


with eclipse integration btw (add a new label `{turn}` to know the next one)
